# ⭐ What is SOLEA OPTIMISED?
**SOLEA OPTIMISED** : as the name suggests—offers a comprehensive upgrade for your Minecraft experience. Not only does it include optimization mods, but it also features numerous graphical enhancement mods to make your game look better while delivering impressive performance.

![SOLEA](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/71414344ccbe04248211deab7febc0387cb4aae6_0.webp)

# Discover
This modpack offers a Minecraft experience with a few of our own tweaks—discover a variety of new details without making the game too complicated. 

![FEATURES](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dd266062e3f8e8c5f0d2c64102064d3ec1721a1f_0.webp)

## Content :
✔️ Fully Optimized with Shader Support

✔️ Many Custom Features for an Improved Experience

✔️ Full Vanilla no custom mods

✔️ Technology without distorting Minecraft

✔️ Optimized for small configurations

✔️ 4 GB ram minimum

✔️ Mods in perpetual evolution

✔️ -100 Mods !!
